method: Every figure is measured like-for-like from nightly price snapshots of Bangladesh phone shops: official against official, import against import, one storage variant against the same variant, and a shop price comparison only across three or more distinct shops.

stories.headline: The Vivo V70 FE 5G unofficial price is ==৳7,009 more== than it was a month ago
stories.caption:
Everyone tells you to wait, that phones only get cheaper. Here is what waiting a month did to the Vivo V70 FE 5G's unofficial price.

৳35,490 on 4 August. ৳42,499 today. 37 phones we track cost more now than they did a month ago:

• Vivo V70 FE 5G: ৳35,490 to ৳42,499 (+20%, unofficial price)
• iQOO Z11 Turbo: ৳50,499 to ৳57,499 (+14%, unofficial price)
• Apple iPhone 15: ৳68,990 to ৳74,999 (+9%, unofficial price)
• Redmi Turbo 4: ৳32,499 to ৳37,490 (+15%, unofficial price)

That is the cheapest listed price on that channel, read every night and plotted above. Full chart:
https://bhalophone.com/phone/vivo-v70-fe-5g

Ever waited for a price to fall and watched it climb?

stories.headline: The Vivo V70 FE 5G official price fell ==৳600== over the same weeks
stories.caption:
The other price of the same phone.

We read the Vivo V70 FE 5G twice every night: once with a brand warranty, once without. Its official price went ৳54,599 to ৳53,999 while its unofficial price went ৳35,490 to ৳42,499. So what the warranty costs:

• On 4 August: ৳19,109
• Today: ৳11,500

Official against official, unofficial against unofficial, every night. Both lines:
https://bhalophone.com/phone/vivo-v70-fe-5g

Is the warranty worth that to you?

stories.headline: The same phone costs ==11.6% more== at Salextra than at the cheapest shop
stories.caption:
Same phone, same storage, same channel. What does each shop want for it on the same night? We ran that 152 times.

Salextra came out 11.6% above the cheapest shop on average. RioInternational came out 1.7%.

• RioInternational: +1.7% (86 comparisons)
• GaziElectronics: +1.7% (34 comparisons)
• Dazzle: +2.7% (27 comparisons)
• SMSGadget: +3.0% (82 comparisons)
• AppleGadgets: +5.3% (72 comparisons)
• SumashTech: +7.1% (131 comparisons)
• Pickaboo: +8.8% (81 comparisons)
• GadgetAndGear: +9.0% (87 comparisons)
• Salextra: +11.6% (27 comparisons)

Shops bundle differently and stock different things, so a premium is not proof of anything by itself. But if you are about to spend six figures, the shop you walk into is worth knowing. Checked every night, every shop we track:
https://bhalophone.com

Which shop do you actually buy from?

stories.headline: Waiting 61 days on the OnePlus 13 saved you ==৳27,900==
stories.caption:
Somebody paid ৳103,899 for a OnePlus 13 back on 4 July. It is ৳75,999 today.

৳27,900, for waiting 61 days. The four phones we have watched fall hardest since the first night anyone here quoted a price:

• OnePlus 13: ৳103,899 to ৳75,999, −27% in 61 days (official price)
• Apple iPhone 16 Plus: ৳184,999 to ৳135,000, −27% in 84 days (official price)
• Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra: ৳245,999 to ৳179,999, −27% in 61 days (official price)
• Xiaomi 17: ৳99,999 to ৳78,000, −22% in 61 days (unofficial price)

Every line is one channel against itself, so a sold-out listing never reads as a price cut. Night-by-night history:
https://bhalophone.com/phone/oneplus-13

Anything you are holding out on? Name it and we will watch it.

stories.headline: Samsung's warranty on the Galaxy Z Fold 5 costs ==৳162,000==
stories.caption:
Official Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 5, 12GB/256GB: ৳285,999.
The identical unofficial box: ৳123,999.

৳162,000 is what the warranty costs you on this phone. Both in stock today. The four widest gaps we can price on both channels right now:

• Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 5 12GB/256GB: official ৳285,999 vs unofficial ৳123,999 (৳162,000 apart)
• Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 12GB/256GB: official ৳224,999 vs unofficial ৳94,990 (৳130,009 apart)
• Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 6 12GB/256GB: official ৳197,999 vs unofficial ৳84,999 (৳113,000 apart)
• Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB: official ৳341,999 vs unofficial ৳239,999 (৳102,000 apart)

Same storage on both sides, always. Quoting the cheapest official against the cheapest unofficial usually compares 512GB with 256GB and doubles the gap. Specs, shops and the full history:
https://bhalophone.com/phone/samsung-galaxy-s25-ultra

Official or unofficial: which way did you go, and would you do it again?

stories.headline: The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 7 lost ==৳10,500== in 30 nights

• Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 7: ৳155,999 to ৳145,499 (-7%, unofficial price)

Official against official, unofficial against unofficial. When a cheap listing sells out and the headline price jumps to the official one, that is not a rise and it is not in this list. Night-by-night history:

stories.headline: Same Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, same storage, ==৳58,000== between two Dhaka shops
